domains.title: Deferred closer source custody
optionalFields: hold.json lastRetentionAttemptAt: persisted watcher backoff timestamp for bounded retry in the verified worker checkout
hold.json resolution: audited continuation or explicit discard, timestamp and its evidence
hold.json publishedHead: continued exact source can satisfy teardown without a bundle
source.json redrive: attempt count, live head, dispatch-key reservation ID, unsettled marker, next due time, deterministic refusal and validated candidate
source.json publishedHead and publishedAt: authoritative publication settles bundled to matches-target
domains.semantics: Unsafe or unreadable exact-target custody holds successors. Clean matching-target source with confirmed cleanup resumes paced retry. Historical bundles stay available while unrelated heads follow ordinary closure. Terminal infrastructure or inconclusive stops refund the matched reservation count and retain the retry clock and candidate. For pre-upgrade controller timeouts, the watcher can finalize proof from the original launch-bound drain, lease disposition and exact-head checks before continuing. Explicit launches[].custodyRequired retains unsafe fallback; legacy retry entries alone and corrupt retry files do not hold unrelated heads. Teardown retries source bundling and continuation uses bounded lock contention recovery. Launch- and attempt-bound decisions live under dispatch/audit/deferred-source-decisions; HQ writes the answer under the custody lock.
